pdfcrop.drop: Drop the PDF whose margins you want gone, or click to choose one
pdfcrop.label.preview: First page preview — only what is inside the red line stays
pdfcrop.status.idle: The file stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
pdfcrop.say.nothingToCrop: There is barely any margin to cut. This document is already full.
pdfcrop.say.willShrink: Cutting the margins shrinks the area by {pct}%. Only what is inside the red line stays.
pdfcrop.err.noInk: No content found — every page is blank, or the document is very faint.
pdfcrop.err.lib: Could not load the PDF engine.
pdfcrop.err.open: Could not open the PDF (it may be password protected).
pdfcrop.say.done: Cropped {n} pages · {size}. The text is still selectable.
